func typechecker_ends_with(s: str, suffix: str) int {
    mut len_s := len(s);
    mut len_suffix := len(suffix);
    if len_s < len_suffix {
        return 0;
    }
    mut end_part := std.str_slice(s, len_s - len_suffix, len_s);
    return std.str_eq(end_part, suffix);
}
